source: ECMWF IFS Open Data 0.25 degree, CC BY 4.0
profile_atlas_format: PNG L, vertically stacked pressure levels, 253 pixels per level

diagnostics.thetae: Approximate equivalent potential temperature, Bolton 1980, 850 hPa
diagnostics.frontogenesis: 850-hPa kinematic horizontal frontogenesis of smoothed theta-e, no diabatic term
diagnostics.pv: Layer-mean approximate 200/250/300 hPa Ertel PV, 3 levels
diagnostics.screening: Objective minima/depth/frontogenesis/wind/theta-e anomaly. NO Shapiro-Keyser or sting-jet verification
diagnostics.cross_section: 925 to 300 hPa native pressure-level forecasts, spatially interpolated along a straight lon-lat segment; subterrain levels masked using surface pressure. Not Lagrangian trajectories
